kind: Actual official Desktop UI model and tool smoke test
evidence: Official Desktop UI and the completed session.v4.jsonl.zstd transcript agree
interpretation: The existing API Key route supports actual model and plugin calls; a browser account login is not required for this provider
The old Desktop root package has substantial fixed input cost even for a single status action
Cache-read tokens are reported separately and must not be confused with uncached input or converted to monetary cost without pricing evidence
limitations: This proves one model/tool call, not the latest source behavior, exploit effectiveness or recall
Transcript usage is actual reported usage, but no complete wire request body was captured
System/message content serialization is not a complete request-cost attribution
No before/after saving is established by this isolated smoke test
